Original15ft retreat is conditional route travel from the last legal whole-body open placement, not automatically center depth15 into a wall. Explicit real5x5 body clearance and recorded entry position are required.
Native Petrified supplies aging/poison/disease/defenses, but not air/food/water exemption or rest accounting. Preserve the local proposed completion for conference instead of calling it inherited.

No printed source size cap does not manufacture unknown Huge/Gargantuan occupancy/carrying/meld rules. Conditional larger recipients require actual completed profiles before current cases can claim legality.

Original shared baselines/status labels are historical. Current Wizard first-distinct prepared matrices use exact actual cadence; current reviewed Gaseous Form and body normalization supersede obsolete pending labels. Do not import unrelated zombie/material/portal shared clauses.

sourceFindings.finding: Dimensional Door and Dimensional Anchor are accepted authored counterparts in AC4reviewed03; old shared text calling them unadopted is historical only. Universal Dimension Door remains distinct and pending.

Alignment Portal is planar/extradimensional nonteleport with sight-through and source-qualified forced traversal. Alignment Nexus Conjuration8 is both planar and teleport. Neither grants its classification to Mystic Gate, which earlier proposed same-plane opaque teleport crossings.

A centered unsqueezed Large10x10footprint has corner radius sqrt50>5 and does not lie inside a diameter10circle. A centered Medium5x5footprint has corner radius sqrt12.5<5. Original Circle scenarios did not give a body fixture; no original scenario is changed or claimed as a full geometry test.

TeleportObject loose worn gear/WIS differs from Shift no worn objects/CHA and InstantSummons no other current custodian. These are full deliberate proposed rules, not a generic teleport-custody inheritance.

Mystic Gate failed wagon scenario preserves the aperture-failure obligation. A successful vehicle transit still requires actual sourced coupled assembly, draft/driver/movement and full arrival geometry; no generic wagon profile is supplied here.

Historical Wizard baseline first-cast Dissonance text does not override the current prepared-first-distinct matrix. Circle30RP/30minutes is three base casts, excluding real study/acceptance/travel and any resource recovery needed by the actual selected caster.

True transformed creature-origin object retains actual identity/source targeting restrictions. It does not become an ordinary eligible item for TeleportObject/InstantSummons. options: Author a bounded persistent room with explicit dimensions, support, environmental behavior and one actual access interface.
Make only a temporary Banishment-sized cell or silently import another game’s Demiplane.
allGroupQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend retain a useful actual private room. GPT must select explicit NEW dimensions/capacity and entry geometry, including all-body fit and mandatory anatomy changes. Ephemeral boundaries must not become free saleable raw materials; supplies and furniture retain actual sources.

allGroupQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Core120ft/Instantaneous describes creation but gives no door duration, directionality, admission credential, remote view or later re-entry.
options: Separate persistent room identity from a finite connection; define full local/remote entry predicates and later reopening.
Treat privacy as absolute invulnerability or grant arbitrary remote entry into any named space.
allGroupQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend explicit NEW entrance duration, actual movement cost, one/two-way choice, permitted users and reopening by the actual room’s retained identity. Publicly seeing a doorway is not necessarily owning its key. No secret-plane location oracle, unprinted attack passage or automatic remote line of effect.

allGroupQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Create a room does not specify one room per caster, replacement of older rooms, abandoned rooms or what happens to stored living creatures and cargo.
options: Choose a finite active-space ownership rule while preserving exact occupants, objects and lawful transfers; never overwrite a nonempty room.
Silently delete an older room and its contents on recast/death or duplicate stored inventories.
allGroupQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend a bounded explicit room/connection registry with stable IDs, actual ownership and deterministic handling of old rooms on recast, death and save/load. Resolve persistent useful storage without making repeated casts unlimited free physical stock. Different casters cannot inherit access by name alone.

allGroupQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Banishment closes on suppression with a scoped terminal-return exception; Faction Portal instead suppresses access until its original deadline. Neither defines Demiplane.
options: Choose separate suppression/dispelling behavior for room and connection, with deterministic settlement of every extant identity.
Borrow whichever earlier ending avoids a hard case without an explicit scoped extension.
allGroupQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend expressly decide whether inaccessible rooms persist and what true room removal does. A closing door never bisects transit. Define actual origins/anchors for visitors born, summoned or transferred inside; no unseen deletion, arbitrary tactical relocation or indefinite imprisonment caused only by a failed placement operation.

allGroupQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: A private extradimensional room does not establish its native inhabitants, souls, safe-rest immunity, relation to the Heartcell or website rings.
options: Use a newly generated spell-space only with bounded privacy and real ongoing creature/effect records.
Assign canonical plane, divine sanctuary, afterlife, protected rest or new native population from its name.
allGroupQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend generated opaque plane/space references and explicitly limited ordinary information/travel interfaces. Any actual escape, summons, rest or resource refill requires its own source. Keep original cosmology open and preserve campaign disclosure boundaries.

allGroupQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Both Illusion8 and Universal8 say trap a creature in an extradimensional labyrinth. Core gives no save or concentration and prints Instantaneous. This is not Mind Maze’s subjective display.
options: Author a genuine extradimensional captivity application with explicit initial resistance, hard-control admission and duration.
Reduce the spell to an observer-private illusion or import an unstated external Maze rule.
allGroupQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend retain real labyrinth displacement and actual agency, preserving both placements and current class-school access. GPT must select NEW save/automatic admission choice, concentration and finite maximum; encounter-removal uses the accepted hard-control gate only where explicitly applicable.

allGroupQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: The labyrinth promise requires a real navigable challenge, but no topology, dimensions, exit condition, INT check or automatic species escape is printed.
options: Define deterministic generated topology/seed and a finite ordinary navigation/escape procedure, including small and large bodies.
Use an abstract roll that makes the labyrinth irrelevant or silently give named creatures automatic escape.
allGroupQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend an executable finite labyrinth with explicit passages, whole-body fit, movement and escape interaction; any check costs, DC, cadence or species privilege are NEW. No regeneration may invalidate visited routes without a stated rule. Preserve meaningful choices and actual action costs.

allGroupQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: No printed rule describes freedom, source suppression, concentration loss, death, corpses, later visitors or expiry inside Maze.
options: Specify a complete closure/escape lifecycle and real body/object placement with bounded source-specific exceptions.
Leave permanent sealed survivors or reuse Banishment’s exceptions without review.
allGroupQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend define terminal return/anchor and settlement for every genuine occupant and object, preserving escaped identities, deaths, source expiry and carried creatures. A source ending never duplicates lost gear or revives a dead target; physical conflict cannot silently extend the effect.

allGroupQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Actual Dimensional Door is same-plane only; Faction Portal may reach a qualifying real headquarters on another plane; accepted True Seeing distinguishes subjective mental effects from physical geometry.
options: Apply each actual escape, information and suppression source by its exact predicate; a real maze remains physically real.
Let True Seeing universally dispel it or assume every teleport escapes it.
allGroupQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend explicit access/knowledge/range/plane/body checks. Keep Maze distinct from accepted Mind Maze and Mental Prison. A named school does not make real walls false or grant immunity. Resolve suppression of target, connection and source separately.

allGroupQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: The source does not specify recasting on an absent target, independent prisoners, shared labyrinths or concurrent caster ownership.
options: Choose one bounded application/space policy with actual perceived targets and original clocks.
Allow hidden absent-target selection, unlimited nested realms or recast-based imprisonment refresh.
allGroupQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend stable per-application identity, explicit replacement/nesting handling and no free target knowledge. Disclose whether separate captives ever share space and how visitors create closure metadata; decide without revising canonical realm identity.

allGroupQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Close ALL connections to a SPECIFIC plane WITHIN1mile; Core range120ft and Instantaneous. No boundary shape or center rule is supplied.
options: Select one actual plane identity plus a fixed local one-mile region, explicitly reconciling120ft placement range.
Treat one mile as target range, silently reduce ALL to one portal, or close all planes.

Include inaccessible/hidden connections without granting a locator. An undefined plane name fails designation without inventing identity.

allGroupQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Actual portals, Planar Window, exile cells and long-term compulsion have distinct crossing/information/source relationships. Close connections does not define what counts.
options: Define an exact connection taxonomy and apply ALL qualifying connections to the selected plane; distinguish existing effects from ongoing links.
End every spell involving a planar creature or classify only visible doorways.
allGroupQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend decide real transit apertures, scrying windows, telepathy or persistent summon tethers individually from actual sources. Do not unsummon a body merely because it previously arrived, sever a soul, erase an existing plane or promote every sustained effect into a connection.

allGroupQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: The verb close and Instantaneous can mean a one-time closure; a continuing prohibition against new connections would be new power.
options: One-time atomic closure of qualifying existing connections; later independent opening remains possible.

allGroupQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend one-time closure unless joint review chooses and labels a finite ongoing ward. Preserve the full one-mile/all-connections benefit. Do not accidentally turn instantaneous closure into permanent global prevention or silently pause independent clocks.

allGroupQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Closing during a genuine transit or exile ending can strand, split or delete bodies unless ordering is explicit; ordinary Ready resolves after its completed trigger.
options: Finish committed atomic crossings, then close later use; explicitly adjudicate true interruption sources and mandatory endings.
Bisect a body or convert ordinary Ready into a mid-transit interrupt.
allGroupQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend deterministic event order, source-specific terminal settlement and exact metadata retention. Decide whether a terminal Banishment return is a sealable connection or a scoped mandatory transition; do not imply the spell inherits or overrides its exception silently.

allGroupQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: No temporary/native/home destination, duration, concentration or return rule accompanies the printed banishment. Ordinary Banishment uses a generated temporary cell; Banish Elemental adopts that only through an explicit extension.
options: Explicitly extend the bounded exile-cell contract with a selected duration and three independent records.
Send to a proved actual origin destination using a new complete return/placement contract.
allGroupQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend the narrow explicit cell extension if it preserves intended banishment without naming unproved native planes; retain Core Instantaneous as original evidence and disclose NEW continuing lifecycle. If a true origin-return interpretation is chosen, require actual provenance, safe deterministic placement and explicit failure behavior rather than inferred lore.

allGroupQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Up to3 selected extraplanar creatures can differ in saves, eligibility, defenses, carried bodies, hard-control history and destination validity.
options: Resolve independent named targets in stable order after one paid cast, preserving each lawful successful/failed result.
Abort/refund all results whenever one target is unknown or silently substitute another hidden eligible target.
allGroupQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Recommend explicit shared versus per-target application ownership, hard-control admissions, independent closure and suppression. No retargeting on a hidden failure, bundled creature-as-cargo trick, inventory duplication or new target fact disclosure.

options: Choose explicit planar relocation plus a persistent escape restriction with full arrival rules.
Choose a binding record whose first lawful arrival establishes confinement, with disclosed current-world effect.

options: Keep the actual living/dead body, source lifetime and independent Hunt/recovery rules; no soul relocation is inferred.

sourceFindings: All seven actual routes are rank9/minimumclasslevel17/base26RP; preserve Action,V/S/F and exact class-school access. Phantom Armageddon has Cleric/Druid/Wizard; Psychic Scream Mage Evocation/Wizard Enchantment; the other five are Wizard-only.

Psychic Scream has three placements with14d6psychic/up to10creatures. Evocation supplies stun; Enchantment/Illusion possible head destruction. Neither a free school switch nor a union of riders is currently selected.

Weird has two placements but one actual Wizard Enchantment route. Its30-foot radius,nightmare captivity and4d10perround are substantive; no existing finite duration or complete trapped state can be assumed.

Phantom Armageddon preserves60-foot radius,12d10necrotic and fear to all enemies. Phantom Cataclysm preserves12d10psychic,one-round stun and subjective world-ending belief; no actual destruction or prophecy is granted.

Frightful Sovereignty preserves one6d6psychic event and WIS-or-flee for three rounds. Successful-save damage and exact movement/Action obligations are explicit questions; ordinary Fear does not itself cause flight.
Mass Phantom Killer preserves up tofive enemies,6d6psychic per round and WIS ending saves. Its independently ending applications are not free retargets; the title adds no instant death or fear.

Reality Break preserves one10d12force event plus meaningful additional effects and WIS saves. A complete native finite effect table/schedule is missing and must be selected; no foreign table or world-rewrite power is assumed.

Full Control15 and Illusion14 acceptances are preserved as exact accepted-but-unapplied context,not current registry changes.39 accepted identities remain unapplied; all23 new choices remain unselected.

sourceFindings: Five identities/seven complete placements,all rank9/base26RP with class17 access. Absolute Gate requires10minutes; Gate,Banishment Gate,Planar Sanctuary and Conjure Demiplane Fortress are Action casts.

Gate has three placements with broader any-plane-or-location Conjuration wording versus another-plane Universal/Transmutation. Actual Cleric route is Universal; Druid/Mage/Wizard route Conjuration. No new Transmutation grant is inferred.

Absolute Gate promises a permanent portal to any known plane or place and CoreUntilDispelled. Druid has no actual grant. Permanence,long casting and genuine known-place eligibility must remain meaningful.

Banishment Gate automatically banishes selected creature types. Automatic trigger,types,destination,duration,hard-denial composition and return require explicit decisions rather than unexamined inheritance of ordinary Banishment.

Planar Sanctuary promises area immunity to effects from a specific plane. Its effect-origin predicate is distinct from Planar Protection creature-arrival provenance and Planar Barrier native/extraplanar predicates.

Conjure Demiplane Fortress promises a permanent extradimensional stronghold,CoreUntilDispelled,with no Cleric grant. Persistent usable fortification,access,materiality,contents and ending need complete treatment.

Faction Portal and Alignment Portal are already reviewed but differ in teleport classification,direction,aperture channels,admission and movement. Their source-specific choices are comparisons,not universal portal rules.

Banishment cell,admission,closure and terminal endpoint-blocker exceptions require explicit extension before use by these spells. All actual bodies,cargo,clocks,death and mandatory transformations remain real.

Original manuscripts,saved website,owner corrections,Q6 and current planar/research context are preserved. Prior post-push labels are historical after verified backup; no new plane mapping,soul theory,clock exception or cosmological identity is selected.
All30 questions remain unselected. Source preparation adds no operative procedure,worked encounter,runtime implementation or canon approval.

openQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: None of the five printed descriptions supplies a complete executable creature profile. Accepted defaults cover some missing ordinary values, but do not invent attacks, anatomy, type, mass, movement modes or a rated herald.
options: Author complete spell-specific profiles with each inherited default and each NEW field explicitly marked.
Bind genuinely complete existing native profiles where exact eligibility and all printed benefits are proven; author only the remaining fields.
openQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Use actual native evidence first. Return complete positive-use profiles, source ownership and resource records; never substitute a foreign monster or mark a missing profile resolved by an eligibility guard.

openQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: The owner-wide one-command and one-offensive-companion allowance is accepted. Several new spells promise multiple attacks, an army, or control over all undead; their additional throughput is not specified.
options: Inherit the accepted shared allowances, expressly defining complete multiattack/pulse components within one real offensive opportunity.
Select and justify a named spell-local exception where necessary to preserve an army/control promise, with exact cross-family budgets.
openQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Do not silently multiply allowances, or silently reduce the promised benefit for tabletop convenience. Identify the real gameplay tradeoff and every affected owner/controller/round ledger.

openQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Creation, transport of an existing being, and a new control relation have different identity, source, cargo and death consequences. Names such as avatar/herald do not decide which exists.
options: Select a generated-body lifecycle for a source that actually supports that reading, with exact same-spell caps and replacement.
Select preexisting identity/transport or control where the wording requires it, with conserved records and an explicit return/ending contract.
openQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Select each identity separately. Keep no-concentration versus concentration, body death versus source removal, and old concentration ending before a failed replacement distinct. No free corpse, soul, inventory, XP or unlimited resummon refresh follows.

openQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: The AC4/AC5/AC6 living-ally healing extensions are named exceptions. Companion10 expressly does not extend them to every new summon. Actual Wizard Conjuration and eligible Flesh Ascendant maximum-HP rules are already settled.
options: Use only healing sources whose actual target predicate already admits the selected new body.
Author a precise healing-target extension for named new profiles without inventing biology or universally changing Undead/Construct targeting.
openQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: State the eligible healing/repair routes and NullDisabled0 recovery for each profile. Inherit actual creation snapshots and dynamic controller bonuses without alias duplication or capacity-growth healing.

openQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: The avatar aura, rot aura and cone need source-local roots and repeated exposure rules. Existing Greater Fire Pet aura, AC6 companion roots and P20 pulse rules have different named scopes.
options: Use explicit per-recipient roots and a stated repeated-exposure schedule with declared family keys.
Use a single rolled pool where justified while retaining independent recipient saves, defenses and exact damage-root ownership.
openQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Specify source body as actual dealer where it acts, original stat owner separately, critical versus save dice, concentration consequences and creation-time Null flags. No owner Veil, lifesteal, resource recovery or harmful repeated tick is inherited by name.

openQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Accepted summon suppression differs: AC6 preserves occupied paused bodies, Companion Knight removes expression temporarily, and Companion Wraith ends its manifestation. None is a universal choice for these five.
options: Select a retained-body or pending-expression policy for each generated profile with exact geometry, identity, clocks and cargo.
Select a terminal expression ending, or suppression of control alone for an existing being, where explicitly justified.
openQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Define partial-body/local-area versus whole-parent suppression, rider-only suppression, pending orders, dispel capture, unsupported Falling and real expiry. A multi-body army requires individual and parent records; no heal, fresh turn or missed-pulse replay on resumption.

openQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Summon Elemental Avatar prints HP180 but no body size, elemental choice, anatomy, mass, attack type or movement modes. The title does not imply all elements, all movement modes or deity embodiment.
options: One complete selected elemental profile, with any element fixed at formation.
A finite menu of complete source-local elemental variants preserving the same printed benefit set.
openQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Provide exact occupied volume, actual mass, handling/carrying, respiration if relevant, attack/saves/checks and perception. Changing appearance or controller cannot refill HP or silently select a new element.

openQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: The source says attacks 3x/round, rather than explicitly naming three Actions. Existing Air Pet multiple attacks can form one damaging Action, but the new per-round ceiling must remain real.
options: Three separately resolved attacks within one commanded offensive Action and one body/numbered-round allowance.
A precisely scheduled split-attack permission with the same genuine three-attack round ceiling and an explicit command exception.
openQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Favor the inherited multiattack shape if it preserves all three attacks. Specify reach, attack/damage profile, target changes, movement between strikes, failed later targets, unused strikes, extra turns, control transfer and recasting.

openQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Elemental resistances is a positive printed clause without an enumerated damage set. It does not say immunity, absorption, healing or adaptive invulnerability.
options: A fixed explicitly enumerated resistance set on the complete profile.
A selected elemental variant with an explicitly enumerated corresponding resistance set.
openQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Retain useful plural resistances and state mixed-damage allocation, exact source-qualified penetration, suppression and form/control changes. Do not invent a missing global elemental-damage taxonomy.

openQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Aura damage has no radius, amount, damage type, target category, trigger, save or overlap rule. Greater Fire Pet uses perceived hostile recipient future STARTs and is only a comparison.
options: A genuine passive aura with exact recipient/geometry/pulse/save/damage rules, distinct from the commanded three strikes.
An explicitly activated aura mode with a stated action relationship, only if the printed passive-looking benefit is consciously reconciled.
openQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Require useful quantified aura behavior. State ally/caster/other-avatar exposure, actual LoE, entry versus START timing, outside-initiative cadence, suppression and whether a pulse consumes any allowance. No secret allegiance oracle.

Expressly reconcile Core to a selected sustaining duration/concentration procedure while preserving the original field unchanged as evidence.

openQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Massive fire serpent supplies a body concept and HP250, but not a Size category, occupied dimensions, body mass, support, locomotion or handling.

openQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: The breath is specifically 6d12 fire in a cone; cone length, source origin, save/result, use cost and frequency are missing.
options: A complete commanded breath Action with a fixed per-round/recharge/use policy.
A complete alternative attack mode sharing its real offensive opportunity with other authored actions.

openQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: No bite, claw, tail attack, spell list or breath-exhaustion fallback is printed. A complete game creature still needs explicit ordinary actions and a useful behavior when breath is unavailable.

Author additional narrowly justified native attacks or maneuvers with complete numeric profiles and clear shared budgets.
openQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Do not claim optional extra attacks were in the source. No attack happens for free on creation; state command hearing/perception, creation-turn eligibility and defensive behavior.

openQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Fire serpent and fire cone do not themselves supply terrain ignition, molten fluid, light, smoke, heat damage to cargo or harvestable fuel.
options: Apply only already-authored environmental/object consequences actually triggered by the breath or body.
Add specifically bounded environmental expressions with complete rates, geometry, object targeting and endings.
openQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Keep the printed fire damage while distinguishing visual presentation from mechanics. Any persistent fire/terrain result must have a real source, finite lifecycle and conserved objects; real carried property does not become conjured loot.

A real called contingent with individual persistent identities, eligibility/consent, source locations and an actual return contract.
openQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Confer on the word army and the service promise. No default conscription of named NPCs, duplication of possessions, new divine authority or universal plane taxonomy. Genuine travel tests apply only to actual transit.

openQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: No soldier count, composition, formation size, quality or CR is printed. Copying Faction Army 3d6/HP20 would be a new design choice, not source recovery.
options: A fixed army-scale count with one or more complete profiled unit roles.
A declared bounded composition budget with complete qualifying profiles and deterministic count/selection.
openQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Supply an actual positive army, not an undefined placeholder or one unrelated pet. Explain its capabilities at 26RP and its one-minute source without claiming balance approval. Every unit has its own body, HP, gear, location and eligibility.

openQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: An army may inherit the shared one-companion offensive Action, but that creates a consequential throughput choice. Faction Army currently allows only one soldier to spend that allowance.
options: Preserve the exact inherited one-soldier offensive command, with a complete account of the army's other useful service.
Author a bounded cohort command/offense exception giving a stated set of real unit actions within one owner transaction.
openQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Discuss the intended benefit rather than silently copying a weak or broad rule. A cohort action must still resolve each body's reach, path, save, ammo, damage root and interruption. No tabletop aggregation may erase separate targets or casualties.

openQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Core gives120ft range but no deployment radius, fitting policy, predeclaration or partial-formation rule for many bodies.
options: Predeclare ordered legal whole-body spaces and form only the selected still-valid count with exact partial-success rules.
Require a fully legal complete declared formation and define an atomic all-or-nothing establishment.
openQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Bind real visibility, LoE, height/support, no overlap, inter-unit order and hidden invalidity after payment. Any partial cohort must have an explicit identity/replacement rule; it grants no after-roll search, crushing or automatic escape.

openQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Serve you is broader than an attack, while the one-minute duration and actual expedition jobs forbid inventing completed watches, labor output, institutional rank or proficiency.
options: Allow complete profiled combat/manipulation/transport services with actual time, capacity and commands.
Also authorize specified skilled tasks by giving complete proficiencies and linking real existing job records.
openQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Preserve meaningful service without phantom offscreen progress. Materials, worker identity, movement, working time and custody remain real; a conjured uniform grants no faction permission, training, tax exemption or Extraction.

openQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: A one-minute concentration army needs individual casualties, local suppression, whole-parent endings and any true returned-person behavior reconciled.
options: Generated bodies end under a selected finite-body policy, with external cargo settled at actual positions.
Called beings retain underlying bodies and use a separately authored lawful return/stranding policy at each ending.
openQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Resolve blocked returns, plane separation, independent dispel of one body versus parent, Null-disabled soldiers and foreign passengers individually. No global rescue immunity, fresh loot or batch recreation of dead units.

options: A genuinely existing eligible unique individual with actual availability, identity and retained resources.
A specifically authored unique herald identity/manifestation with a registry and complete source-local definition, explicitly selected as NEW.
openQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Keep unique meaningful across recasts, casters, control and concurrent manifestations. No generic unnamed unrated profile may quietly replace it. A new herald must not silently become a canonical god or rewrite an established NPC.

openQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: CR15+ is an inclusive lower bound with no printed upper cap. The supplied72-entry bestiary includes the Director-sealed CR22 Elemental Lumen, but a source stat block is not an operationally accepted summon profile.

openQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Aid you does not explicitly grant domination, universal obedience, secret extraction, free finite powers, a bargain price or willing consent.

openQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Return actual useful aid and precise refusal/illegality behavior without making every positive case a rejection. Name any cost or permission added as NEW; no hidden deity veto, compulsory oath violation or free resource refresh.

openQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: Arrival and ending depend on the selected identity. Lumen's preserved source specifically says it cannot be permanently displaced from its arena while its Seal is active; that does not automatically answer a temporary call.

A source-local manifestation while preserving the distinct existing identity and prohibiting ungranted duplicate bodies or arena benefits.
openQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Confer on the actual Gate-bound text if using that candidate. No blanket immunity to Anchor/wards, automatic bypass of arena objectives, stolen Gate rewards or invented forced-return exception. Preserve its source and the public/Director knowledge boundary.

openQuestions.exactSourceOrConflict: The herald may have real knowledge, equipment, spellcasting, finite uses and continuing effects. Summoning does not inherently disclose every hidden record or refresh anything.
options: Use the exact selected being's extant resources, knowledge permissions and agency, conserved across arrival/return.
Define a complete finite manifestation resource budget distinct from the original, explicitly resolving what information and child effects it can produce.
openQuestions.recommendationAndConsequences: Keep real spell costs/components/repertoire/concentration/cadence, gear custody and downstream effect expiry. Aid is not automatic prophecy, all research completion or disclosure beyond the failed Sixth Gate. Supply complete positive ability use before calling the case complete.

sourceFindings: All five are rank9/class17/base26RP, Action/120ft/V,S,F. Four have concentration up to one minute; Wyrm uniquely has Core Instantaneous. These known fields are not reopened as questions.

Druid/Mage/Wizard access the three Conjuration identities. Herald is Divination through Cleric/Wizard; Decay is Necromancy through Cleric/Druid/Wizard. Mage does not inherit the last two and Cleric does not inherit the Conjuration trio.

Elemental Avatar retains180HP,three attacks per round,plural elemental resistances and actual aura damage. Wyrm retains250HP,a massive serpent body and6d12 fire cone. No nominal label substitutes for complete effects.

Planar Army retains an army of extraplanar creatures serving the caster. Herald retains a unique eligible creature and open-endedCR15+ lower bound. Decay retains250HP,real aura of rot and commands all undead without silently importing Command Undeath's two/exactCR2 limits.

Accepted ordinary command/attached-phase rules are supplied in full. Explicit multiple attacks can share one offensive Action; extra turns do not multiply numbered-round allowances. Army and chained undead command throughput are consequential unresolved source-local choices.

Complete applied AC4/AC5/AC6 comparisons show source-specific healing/suppression/creation and transport decisions. Their current accepted procedures govern stale internal proposal labels; the new five do not inherit every exception by analogy.

Actual Companion10 exact05 source/model/casebook/register/acceptance and its two held exactCR2 cases are included unchanged. Control15 and preparation-only copied Ready context remain accepted-but-unapplied and scoped; the independent five positive-content holds remain open.

The bounded original bestiary scan covers67 public and5 Director-sealed entry files, all preserved in full. Lumen is printed Large Elemental/CR22, has a Gate-bound clause, fragmentary Sixth-Gate disclosure limits and incomplete action geometry. Original cosmology manuscripts, saved website, current owner corrections and Q6 are supplied. Avatar,extraplanar,herald andUndead do not invent native planes,soul identity,divine authority,Hunt exceptions or an Equation.

Full real body,source,gear,resource,clock,agency and job identities must survive control/transport/suppression/ending. Literal fictional complexity is handled by software; no tabletop simplification is an active requirement.

sourceFindings: All four are rank9/class17/base26RP,Action,V/S/F. Reverse Gravity Field alone has60ft cast range; the other three have120ft. Eternal Anvil Core duration is1round; the other three are Instantaneous. These source facts are not reopened.

The three Transmutation spells use Druid/Mage/Wizard access. Planar Collapse uses Universal through Cleric/Mage/Wizard; Druid does not acquire it from another class school. No transmutation grant is supplied to Cleric by the group.

Eternal Anvil keeps a massive war-forge hammer,5d12 force and1round Stunned. Skybrand proves one possible effect-only model but its two attacks,command,concentration and60s lifespan do not automatically apply.

Reverse Gravity Field keeps everything in60ft radius moving60ft up with real later fall damage. The current Falling bridge uses up to300ft descent per actual step and min(10,floor(uncontrolledFeet/20))d6; ordinary60ft is3d6,not6d6. Feather Fall is an Action with its own nonzero landing exposure.

Actual Prone is distinct from forced displacement,Stunned and hard Action denial. Force Spike supplies a reviewed example of damage first and a separate Prone-only save,not a mandatory resolution template for these four.

Transmute Flesh to Energy preserves12d10 chosen energy and explicit resistance bypass. Immunity,prevention,sharing,temporary HP,Null provenance,death and physical body loss require their actual separate source rules.

Planar Collapse retains all12d6force/Prone/exile consequences. Exact existing Banishment cell/admission/closure/conflict/terminal-return rules are provided in full but need an explicit extension; no native plane identity or new cosmology is supplied by the name.

The unaccepted Rank8Damage6 return and all eight local findings/correction request are included as proposed comparison evidence. Its559 integrity checks and92-of96 finite diagnostics do not grant semantic acceptance; the six identities are not added to39 accepted-but-unapplied.

Full pending Reverse Gravity/Telekinesis/Disintegrate,catastrophe and storm/control conferences remain comparisons only. Existing authored rules are inherited within exact scope; no rejected fixture geometry or missing Ready concentration event is repeated as an approved example.

Full original cosmology manuscripts,saved website and current owner corrections accompany actual body,equipment,healing,damage,control,clock and class sources. No donor powers,foreign spell imports,Equation reconstruction or Hunt exception is invented.

sourceFindings: Both identities have one exact Conjuration placement, rank9/class17/base26RP/Action/120feet/V,S,F for Druid,Mage,Wizard. Convergence is one minute without concentration; Fusion is concentration up to one minute.
All four base pet procedures are currently applied authored sources. The old CJ9 text describing Water Pet as pending is historical only; AC4 reviewed03 and its acceptance receipt now govern it.

Base Fire HP10/AC13/one1d8fire; Air HP20/AC15/two1d6slashing in one offensiveAction/noFly; Earth HP30/AC17/one1d10bludgeoning plus Large-or-smaller STR knockdown; Water HP35/AC14/2d6heal OR1d10cold. Retain complete profiles and limitations, not these summaries alone.

Base Air20lb,Earth300lb,Water150lb. Water expressly has six10 abilities; Fire/Air/Earth checks+0 do not fill six missing scores. Fire mass is not supplied in its current card. Any additional field needed for Fusion must be labeled NEW scoped completion.
Water heal consumes owner shared offensive/support allowance; it is not a free second companion action. Its healing admission and suppression clauses cannot be globally extended by analogy.

Greater Fire and Air are complete applied comparisons, while Greater Earth and Water remain in two separate pending conferences. Genuine eligibility must not silently shrink to only base pets just to avoid those interfaces.

The separate Mage Elementalist Elemental Fusion is an acquired rank5 damage card and grants no ordinary rank9 pet merge. Spell Tether,Tethered Cast,Dual Cast,Arcane Fusion and Empowered Link keep their actual acquisition and restrictions.

A functioning Fusion needs both a concentration bridge for the required existing pet and a real positive second casting opportunity. Neither is supplied by merely restating global concentration/action limits.

Source-specific clocks, Null recipient/dealer roots, damage/healing, transformed-body custody, legal endings and scoped suppression remain distinct. No animal biology,soul transfer,new plane or Hunt exception follows from elemental names.

Rank7 identity return is preserved but requires three local fixture corrections; its current full correction packet is prepared and unsent. It is not accepted authority. Rank8 correction11 remains an independently active conference.
